task: 69P Part 6 - stale-data protection + live anomaly investigation (user-requested at 14:36 BST)
trigger: User reported /ping showing Pipeline DEGRADED / MARKET disconnected / 0 bars/events / no heartbeat / all Quant counters zero, while the PIV runtime independently emitted STALE_DATA for COST at 13:32 UTC -- asked to prove whether (A) IEX runner receiving fresh bars but /ping reads a disconnected legacy path, or (B) the actual feed is down, before changing anything.
method: Read-only investigation only. (1) Extracted every STALE_DATA/SESSION_READINESS_* event from piv_events.jsonl since today's market open. (2) Independently queried Alpaca's /v2/stocks/bars/latest endpoint (feed=iex) -- the EXACT same endpoint/params talonx_piv/session_runner.py's fetch_bars_latest() itself calls -- for all 35 universe symbols, completely independent of the running process's internal state. (3) Cross-checked against session_readiness_state.json's per-minute `observed` timestamp arrays (also written by the live process, from real per-bar arrival, not from /ping). (4) Traced session_runner.py's _finalize_readiness()/READY_AT gating to explain the separate 'Quant: 0' figures.

stale_events_since_open.note: Several of these (LRCX, ADBE) had already recovered (fresh bar arrived, _stale_flagged.discard) by the time of this investigation -- staleness here is per-symbol and transient, not a one-way total outage. Near-identical pattern (same symbols, same ~13:30-13:40 UTC window) observed on 2026-08-24 (yesterday) at the same point in the session, suggesting this is a real, reproducible characteristic of IEX-specific trade activity for these particular names in the first ~10 minutes after open, not a one-off glitch.

independent_ground_truth_check.conclusion: The live Alpaca IEX feed IS delivering fresh bars for the large majority (80-89% across two independent snapshots) of the 35-symbol universe, improving over time as expected. The specific stale symbols match the runtime's own STALE_DATA events exactly. This is NOT a feed-wide outage.

root_cause_of_misleading_ping_market_sec.finding: talonx_piv/session_runner.py's SessionRunner calls Alpaca's REST bars/latest endpoint directly (fetch_bars_latest()) -- it never touches talonx_ingest's WebSocket/polling machinery or writes to the Redis WS-heartbeat key / metrics:{date}:ingest:* counters that talonx_dispatch/telegram_listener.py's /ping MARKET section (_ws_status/_market_feed_freshness/_market_section) reads. Those keys are therefore genuinely absent from PIV's Redis usage -- correctly 'no data' from that subsystem's point of view, but the /ping code interprets absence as 'Disconnected'/'DEGRADED', which reads as a system-health claim rather than a subsystem-scope statement.
root_cause_of_misleading_ping_market_sec.quant_zero_separately_explained: session_runner.py's _finalize_readiness() only populates self._ready_symbols at/after 10:00 ET (READY_AT); until then it is None, and line 212's `if self.decision_engine is not None and self._ready_symbols:` is falsy, so decision_engine.on_bars() is never called and QuantScanner has genuinely evaluated zero candidates so far. This is CORRECT, expected behavior for 14:36 BST (09:36 ET, before the 10:00 ET finalization gate) and is unrelated to feed health or the MARKET-section labeling issue.

classification_reasoning: No false DATA is reported anywhere (the new PIV block from the earlier Task 69P fix correctly states 'Alpaca IEX' as the live feed provider, and the ingest-pipeline fields correctly show 0/absent for a pipeline that is genuinely not in use) -- but the PRE-EXISTING 'Pipeline: DEGRADED' / 'Source: Disconnected' labels are misleading because they read as whole-system health when they are actually scoped to one specific, unused subsystem. This is a real defect in observability presentation, not a data-integrity or feed-connectivity defect. MARKET_FEED_NOT_CONNECTED does NOT apply.
action_taken: Session NOT restarted (per instruction). A minimal, additive label-clarification fix was committed to talonx_dispatch/telegram_listener.py (see git log) -- does not affect the already-running process's in-memory behavior (Python does not hot-reload), so today's live /ping will continue to show the same MARKET-section wording until the next session start; recorded here and in the EOD notes for the next session to pick up automatically.
decision_path_impact: NONE -- decision_eligible was already correctly empty (pre-10:00 ET), independent of this finding. No signal, order, or strategy-semantics change was made or is warranted.
